steps.sql: SET NOCOUNT OFF; CREATE TABLE typed_stage(id INT PRIMARY KEY,n INT,m MONEY,label NVARCHAR(12),r REAL,d DECIMAL(5,2),tm TIME(2),v INT DEFAULT 9); INSERT INTO typed_stage VALUES(10,7,123.45,N'old',0,0,'00:00:00',1)

DECLARE @divisor INT=2; WITH s AS (SELECT @divisor AS divisor) UPDATE t SET id=t.id+100,n=(t.n/s.divisor)*2,label=t.m,m=t.m+0.005,r=1.234567890,d=3.456,tm='12:34:56.127',v=DEFAULT OUTPUT deleted.id,inserted.id,inserted.n,inserted.label,inserted.m,inserted.r,inserted.d,inserted.tm,inserted.v,inserted.n/4*4 AS whole FROM typed_stage t CROSS JOIN s
SELECT id,n,m,label,r,d,tm,v FROM typed_stage ORDER BY id
